indicator_name: GDP volume index by expenditure, by component, year-to-date
description: ИФО ВВП методом конечного использования, нарастающим итогом с начала года
unit: % of the same period of the previous year, year-to-date
methodology: Year-to-date columns of the 2007–present sheet (one header reads «9 месяц 2012г.»); 2007 Q1 – 2026 Q1 on 2026-09-23. Same rows as GDP_EXPENDITURE_VOLUME_INDEX — no index for net exports, inventories and valuables.
transformation: as published: the year-to-date period (January-March, January-June, January-September, the year) in % of the same period of the previous year -- not converted to discrete quarters
